info.title: SwarmPay API
info.description:
Plan an event across two merchants and pay each one only on its agreed terms: tents at checkout through PayPal, catering authorized and captured only after a signed venue receipt. Every payment command goes through the AgentSafe gateway; agents use the MCP server at /mcp with an organizer's agent token and can never approve a plan.

Authenticate with a session cookie (sign in, or the local demo session), and send the CSRF header from /api/session on every state-changing request.
